headline: 小黄人怪兽霸榜 蜘蛛侠新篇领跑周热度
headlineEn: Minions and Big Monster Dominate; Spider-Man New Chapter Leads Weekly Buzz
summary: 今日院线零新片，本周已有6部新片开画。热搜榜上《小黄人与大怪兽》领跑，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》蓄势待发，青年华盛顿、激情邀约、奥德赛紧随其后。待映项目《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》引发关注。
summaryEn: No new films released today; six new titles opened this week. Hot searches led by Minions and the Big Monster, with Spider-Man: Brand New Day building momentum, followed by Young Washington, Passionate Invitation and Odyssey. Upcoming titles Escape from Dead End Street and OK Boss Lady 2 are drawing attention.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周累计6部新片
industryHighlights.en: No new releases today; 6 new films this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《小黄人与大怪兽》登顶今日热度榜
industryHighlights.en: Minions and the Big Monster tops today's trending chart.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑周榜，话题持续升温
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leads weekly rankings and keeps generating buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》定档在即
industryHighlights.en: Escape from Dead End Street and OK Boss Lady 2 are set for upcoming release.
